_comment: Local MuseTalk lip-sync configuration (D42). No network calls — the studio never integrates third-party lip-sync APIs.

audio.note: Feed the isolated vocals stem (POST /api/audio/separate), not the full mix — speech-trained models sync markedly worse on full mixes.

inference._comment: Command template with {video} {audio} {output} {weights_dir} {prep_dir} {avatar_key} {batch_size} {float16_flag} {scratch_dir} placeholders. CONFIRM against the installed MuseTalk version on the Windows GPU box before setting — CLI flags drift between releases (v1.5 uses --inference_config YAML + --result_dir, not positional args). Empty means fail-open with guidance.

mock._comment: DEV-ONLY. When true, the adapter copies the input video to the output instead of running the model, so the full batch workflow (chunk -> queue -> stitch) can be exercised with no GPU and no weights. NEVER true for real output.

preparation._comment: Avatar preparation cache dir. NOTE: MuseTalk v1.5 has no latent-prep CLI — its reusable artifact is the face-coordinate pickle via --use_saved_coord. The latents.pt cache here is aspirational until the v1.5 command template is configured; preparation is skipped when no template is set.
